facts.title: Angst

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Once the killer crosses the threshold into the secluded house, the family's fight to survive within their own walls turns immediate and merciless.
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Freshly released from prison, a killer invades an isolated home where a woman, her daughter, and her disabled son are trapped inside. Gerald Kargl directs this taut 1983 Austrian crime thriller.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Heavy, suspenseful, and deeply unsettling. An uncompromising 75-minute watch best experienced alone.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: At a compressed 75 minutes, Gerald Kargl delivers an intensely focused, heavy-hitting Austrian horror thriller that wastes no time locking into high-stakes dread.
